title: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: The following verbs belong to the "**Е**" type of conjugation: **думать** — **я думаю**, **ты думаешь** … **они думают**; **слушать**; **спрашивать**. The verb **лежать** belongs to the "**И**" type of conjugation: **я лежу**, **ты лежишь** … **они лежат**.

The verbs **писать** and **жить** belong to the first "**Е**" type of conjugation, but do not follow exactly the pattern: **я пишу**, **ты пишешь** … **они пишут**; **я живу**, **ты живёшь** … **они живут**. The letter **с** in the infinitive form **писать** is replaced by the letter **ш** in all forms of the present tense. The letter **в** is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb **жить**.

The verbs **сидеть** and **видеть** belong to the 2nd "**И**" type of conjugation. Notice that the consonant **д** changes into **ж** in the first person singular: **я сижу**, **ты сидишь**; **я вижу**, **ты видишь**.
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.
Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: What's the difference between A and B?
exercises.why: **отличаться → отличается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: There's a big storm coming.
exercises.why: **надвигаться → Надвигается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Сколько раз в минуту в среднем ___ (моргать) человек?
exercises.prompt: On average, how many times per minute does a person blink?
exercises.why: **моргать → моргает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Во всём мире почти девятьсот миллионов человек ___ (недоедать).
exercises.prompt: Internationally, almost 900 million people don't have enough to eat.
exercises.why: **недоедать → недоедают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I work at the consulate.
exercises.why: **работать → работаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Многие ___ (верить), что знание китайского поспособствует их карьере.
exercises.prompt: Many believe the ability to speak Chinese will advance their careers.
exercises.why: **верить → верят** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: When does the game begin?
exercises.why: **начинаться → начинается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It's so muggy; I think it will thunder in a short while.
exercises.why: **думать → думаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: I live on the outskirts of Boston.
exercises.why: **жить → живу** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: How is your job search going?
exercises.why: **идти → идут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Когда я ___ (говорить) на японском, это звучит по-детски.
exercises.prompt: When I speak Japanese, I sound like a child.
exercises.why: **говорить → говорю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: I see that you bought candles.
exercises.why: **видеть → вижу** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Sickness empties the wallet.
exercises.why: **опустошать → опустошают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Тишина такая, что слышно, как за стеной ___ (тикать) часы.
exercises.prompt: It is so quiet one can hear the clock tick behind the wall.
exercises.why: **тикать → тикают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: She gives him the creeps.
exercises.why: **бросать → бросает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Больше не ___ (существовать) границы между чистой и прикладной математикой.
exercises.prompt: There are no longer boundaries between pure and applied mathematics.
exercises.why: **существовать → существует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: ___ (хотеть), я спою песенку, поглаживая тебя ложкой по лбу?
exercises.prompt: Do you want me to sing a song while petting your forehead with a spoon?
exercises.why: **хотеть → Хочешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Five times two equals ten.
exercises.why: **два равняется** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (равняться → равняется).

exercises.prompt: What sound does a giraffe make?
exercises.why: **издавать → издаёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is giddy.
exercises.why: **кружиться → кружится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
